answer: Farming becomes a dawn bet on surviving 92 epochs of grading, and every orchard settlement recomputes the meadow schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 92 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 7 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 11 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
